activity.notes: Djoser (Netjerykhet) was a Third Dynasty king of Egypt. ATLAS follows the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities chronology of approximately 2667–2648 BCE and preserves both boundaries as approximate.

sources.title: The Step Pyramid Complex of Djoser — Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities
sources.citation_text: Egypt's Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities identifies Netjerykhet, better known as Djoser, as the Third Dynasty king who reigned approximately 2667–2648 BCE.
